info.name: Mobile HR API — Full Test Scenarios
info.description:
Complete scenario suite (happy + negative + security) encoded from TEST_SCENARIOS.md.

Run order matters: Pre-flight → Auth → Profile → Meta → Leaves → Attendance → Payslips → Cross-cutting → Auth/Logout.

Pre-request scripts seed dynamic data (dates, device IDs). Test scripts assert envelope shape, status codes, and security constraints.
